scope: Descriptive matched TRAIN configurations: vary one physical-key coordinate, other four exactly fixed; average replicas, compare min/max available coordinate. Gas peak uses actual saved endpoints<=32.2s. Projection is sum(true_delta*predicted_delta)/sum(true_delta^2), not fitted model performance, a causal effect, or a universal sensitivity. Observed-history one-step retains recurrent memory driven by observed history. Same nominal peak can occur at different times. Angle endpoints are an exploratory coordinate comparison, not a circular trend. No validation/test use or optimizer updates.
